### Verification / 验证

### Safety and compatibility / 安全与兼容性

Describe permission, storage, dependency and migration changes, if any. / 如涉及权限、存储、依赖或迁移，请说明影响。

- [ ] No credentials, private configuration, device records or generated output are included. / 未包含凭据、私有配置、设备记录或生成产物。

- [ ] New public files are explicitly listed in `release-files.json`. / 新增公开文件已明确列入 `release-files.json`。
- [ ] Contributions follow `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the project license. / 贡献符合 `CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md` 与项目许可。
